path_check.finding: Every run has two distinct absolute paths: sibling agg/ and noagg/ directories with different basenames. The six canonical-run roots are also distinct.

hash_check.finding: Each pair is byte-identical, but no pair is the same path.

implementation_provenance.code/main_lite.py::setup: For val/test, chunkify_valtest=True; chunk_length_valtest=input_size_data; stride_valtest=int(stride_fraction_valtest*input_size_data). CLI default stride_fraction_valtest=1.0.
implementation_provenance.six_formal_commands: All use --input-size 10 --fs-data 500, hence input_size_data=5000 and val/test stride=5000. The established records500 contract contains 5000-sample records and fold-10 has 2198 unique ECG IDs.
implementation_provenance.code/clinical_ts/data/time_series_datase: If idmap has no duplicate values, it returns preds,targs unchanged. Mean aggregation is only performed when an ECG has multiple test segments.
implementation_provenance.code/main_lite_base.py::on_valtest_epoch: It computes noagg from preds_all/targs_all, computes agg via aggregate_predictions(..., aggregate_fn=np.mean), then exports both when export_predictions and test are true.
implementation_provenance.code/main_lite_base.py::_export_predicti: It always saves two separate NPZ files, selecting sibling directories agg or noagg, and writes the supplied preds/targs/lbl_itos/epoch arrays. It does not make one filename an alias of the other.
implementation_provenance.accepted_overlay_review: The locally visible overlay diff changes only resampling-condition logic and ECG-FM wrapper import/branch. It contains no prediction-export or aggregation change.

answer_to_semantic_questions.noagg: Per-test-segment prediction and target arrays before record-level aggregation.
answer_to_semantic_questions.agg: Mean aggregation of per-test-segment arrays within each ECG identity, retaining one target per ECG.
answer_to_semantic_questions.normally_different_shape: Only when a test ECG yields multiple segments. There is no general requirement that they differ.
answer_to_semantic_questions.legal_same_content: Yes. With one segment per ECG, aggregate_predictions returns the original arrays, and the exporter serializes two byte-identical but separately named NPZ files.
answer_to_semantic_questions.only_aggregate_then_double_label: No. The locked exporter receives and saves both variables separately; equality here follows identity aggregation rather than a provenance label referring twice to a single remote path.

row_shape_evidence.proof_strength: Source-and-configuration proof: all six commands use whole-record 10 s test windows, the locked identity-aggregation branch is exact, and canonical fold-10 metadata has 2198 unique ECG IDs. The six remote NPZ bytes were not locally copied or opened.
row_shape_evidence.supporting_local_historical_artifact: experiments/ptbxl_all/ecg_jepa/test_0_epoch_100_agg.npz and noagg.npz are distinct paths with identical SHA256 56f20d55fb4f9f496498cf1f5f62799ec1edc901408c49831c18bd493c784915. Read-only NPZ metadata shows both contain preds/targs (2198,71), lbl_itos (71,), epoch scalar. This is the same locked ECG-JEPA 10 s route and corroborates the semantics; it is not substituted for the six source artifacts.

strict_mapping_impact: No additional impact from equal agg/noagg bytes. The applicable evidence is record-level (2198 rows); ordinary identity/order provenance requirements remain unchanged and were not adjudicated here.
bootstrap_impact: None. The aggregated record-level arrays are the metric/bootstrap input; identity aggregation is a no-op for these runs.
final_metric_impact: None from this finding. The equality is implementation-defined under the recorded whole-record test configuration.
minimal_future_provenance_remediation: For future delivery manifests, record input_size_data, stride_valtest, unique idmap count, noagg/agg shapes, and an explicit aggregation_was_identity flag. Do not alter existing scientific artifacts.
